proposition: In 830/1427 the Hurufi Aḥmad-i Lur attacked Shāhrukh outside the congregational mosque in Herat and was killed; Ibn Turka, who had just left Herat, was recalled, stripped of position and property, imprisoned, tortured and exiled on the basis of claimed Hurufi sympathies.

mediation.who: Aḥmad-i Lur's attack on Shāhrukh, Herat, 830/1427
mediation.where: MK citing Binbaş, 'The Anatomy of an Attempted Regicide'
